sources.title: Thinking in Boxes — 3D Editing in Real Images
sources.snippet: This "thinking in boxes" interface, where each box face is color-coded to convey 3D orientation, gives precise control over translation, rotation, scaling, and viewpoint changes in real images while preserving scene and object identity, and recovering previously unseen object regions.
